incorrect_inferences: The first pass hypothesized Isp might follow the upper route and Pac might use an alternative lower route. The authored barriers and trace show the opposite split: Pac upper, Isp lower.
The idle “recover” label was treated as an unverified mechanic; source and idle-time attack behavior resolve it as automated interference presentation, not actual human recovery.
changed_judgments: Reasoning and cooperation receive 3 because two dependent handoffs and a timed passenger transfer are required; they were null when only the subtitle was visible.
Execution receives 2 for Pac’s two jumps around the passenger ride, while the Isp lower route is walking; the trace confirms the route does not require repeated precision jumps.
Timing is 2 because FLOAT provides a finite dismount window and CROSS must be held until reconnection, but bubble cycles repeat and the pad hold is controllable.
Hazards is 0 because source defines no hazards and the ordinary route has zero deaths; recovery cost is low because both can regroup on safe continuous floor.
